description: This file defines the class SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButton, which is a widget for rendering and handling subpanel top buttons in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM. It includes methods for constructing buttons, generating forms or URLs, and retrieving relationship information for subpanels.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButton
classes.description: A widget class extending SugarWidget, used for rendering top buttons on subpanels in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM. It provides methods for button HTML generation, form creation, and relationship name retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the button object with module, title, access key, and form value, translating labels if needed.

methods.name: getWidgetId
methods.description: Returns a unique widget ID, optionally appending '_button'.

methods.name: _get_form
methods.description: Generates an HTML form or URL with hidden fields based on provided definitions and additional form fields.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Creates HTML for the button, optionally as a form or a link, considering ACL restrictions.

methods.name: _create_json_encoded_popup_request
methods.description: Encodes popup request data as a JSON string.

methods.name: get_subpanel_relationship_name
methods.description: Retrieves the relationship name for a given subpanel definition.
